title: Sunday · the Rain, 2011
logline: Fourteenth January. The first Rain after the sabbatical. Three tiers of the bay. The strip is quieter than it was.

margin.note: The gull, and under the date, small, a second date.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the mudflats in rain from the bluff. Gray on gray. Nobody.

image.prompt: mudflats at low tide in January rain seen from a bluff, gray on gray watercolor, no figures, no words

panels.name: Flats

panels.composition: Tier 2: the drift log. A man sitting on it with a dog in his lap, in the rain, from behind.

image.prompt: a man seen from behind sitting on a bleached drift log in the rain with an old dog in his lap, watercolor, no words

panels.name: Log

panels.composition: Tier 3: the flats, the rain thinning, the man walking back carrying the dog. A second date under the mark.

image.prompt: a man carrying an old dog back across mudflats as the rain thins, watercolor, no words

panels.name: Back

art.line: brush-pen; the flats cleaner; Sundays the point
